protocol.model: Hypothetical finite-state S-led proposal family; not fitted party intentions.
protocol.cabinet_family: S plus every subset of C,V,MP: eight proposals; other cabinets outside scope.
protocol.state: (three-bit policy mask, C composition condition relaxed, V essential-inclusion condition relaxed)
protocol.pm_actions: S Yes. C non-No iff its policy requirement met and either V outside cabinet or C clause relaxed. MP non-No iff its policy met. V non-No iff its policy met and either V not essential, V in cabinet, or V clause relaxed. Cabinet members Yes; admitted nonmember support abstains. Other parties No except explicit external abstention buffers.
protocol.V_essential: With all other party actions held fixed: other_non_No<175<=other_non_No+V_seats. Hopeless proposals are not V-essential.
protocol.consent: S consents; every other included member must have its policy requirement met; included C additionally requires its composition condition. Consent is separate from PM nonrejection.
protocol.budget_support: Not modelled; no inference from cabinet or PM actions.
protocol.cost_sensitivity: Baseline profile; uniform policy costs1,2,3 crossed with uniform clause-release costs1,2,3; minimum cost recalculated, no utility estimation.
protocol.profile_population: All distinct eight-party seat vectors in results/interactions/seat-profiles.json; not independent elections.
protocol.anonymous_capacity_sensitivity: 0..60 existing outsider No seats moved to abstention, full-policy strict clauses; no party-level mapping inferred.
protocol.process_pressure: None, or release C/V clause at an explicitly specified total formal rejection1..4 later than the initial counter, provided two synthetic release units available.
protocol.process_formal_limit: At most four TOTAL formal rejections. The fourth rejection terminates before a subsequent concession. The actual cutoff counter2 leaves at most two additional rejected proposals.
protocol.process_patience: Additional formal-vote horizons1..4 when starting0,1..2 when starting2.
protocol.process_agendas: Every8! cabinet order; exactly enumerated as1680 distinct first-four prefixes weighted4!. These counts are design coverage, not political probabilities.
protocol.adaptive_control: After the hypothetical clause release, search all eight proposals for an agreement before choosing the next formal proposal.
protocol.null_controls: Repeated unchanged proposals; exploratory-only evaluations never increase formal rejection counter; underfunded pressure does not relax a clause.
protocol.proposal_evaluation_unit: One modeled proposal assessment, not one observed speaker exploratory mandate.
protocol.diagnostics: Enumerate all monotone-concession edges, recording No-count increases and agreement losses separately. Pivotality feedback was identified before the expanded run.
protocol.source_scope: Chronology and actor statements anchor questions only. Future candidate-specific PM and budget actions remain unknown in the documentary layer.
protocol.development_status: Retrospective specification, frozen before the expanded 26-profile/process run. Baseline unit examples and mathematical checks had already been inspected. Not a blind or prospective political registration.
